_comment: Tests the always-on 'How to Document Context' rule doc-this installs. Configs are with_rule / without_rule (the rule block present/absent in the staged CLAUDE.md), NOT with_skill/without_skill — the doc-this skill is copied into BOTH arms, so the rule block is the only variable. Each case is an ACTION: the agent makes a real code change with Edit/Write in an isolated clean room, and grade.py reads the mutated files back. Per case: change_file/change_keywords (the code change actually landed; file may be newly created), doc_file (the doc that covers the change), doc_must_exist (the doc must exist after — for create-a-doc cases), doc_required (AND-of-ORs, must all appear in doc_file), doc_forbidden (none may appear in doc_file — the stale fact is gone), optional secondary_doc (recorded as a metric, not pass/fail), and tool_budget. Keyword matching is case-insensitive substring; pick doc_forbidden strings that are NOT substrings of the desired new content.

evals.name: modify-reference-in-doc
evals.prompt: The billing service should retry a failed payment capture 5 times instead of 3. Make that change.
evals.expected_output: Change RETRY_ATTEMPTS from 3 to 5 in services/billing/config.py, and reconcile the typed doc that restates it — services/billing/docs/retry.reference.md must now say 5 attempts, not '3 attempts'. The covering doc here is a docs/*.reference.md, not the README (the README points to it).

evals.name: refactor-update-manifest
evals.prompt: Split services/auth/session_tokens.py into two files: access_tokens.py (holding issue_access_token) and refresh_tokens.py (holding issue_refresh_token). Remove the original session_tokens.py.
evals.expected_output: Create access_tokens.py and refresh_tokens.py, remove session_tokens.py, and update the '## Files' manifest in services/auth/README.md so it lists the two new files and no longer lists session_tokens.py. The README's file manifest is the doc that goes stale on a structural refactor.

evals.name: add-function-update-readme
evals.prompt: Add a push notification channel to the notify service: add a send_push(user, message) function to services/notify/sender.py.
evals.expected_output: Add send_push to services/notify/sender.py and update services/notify/README.md '## Channels' to include push. Ideally also add a typed doc under services/notify/docs/ (recorded as a secondary metric, not required to pass).

evals.name: new-module-create-readme
evals.prompt: Add a new audit module at services/audit/ with an audit.py that logs admin actions.
evals.expected_output: Create services/audit/audit.py that logs admin actions, and — because a new folder needs documenting — create services/audit/README.md describing the module. Ideally also add a row for audit/ to the parent services/README.md manifest (recorded as a secondary metric).

evals.name: parent-doc-reconcile
evals.prompt: Increase the billing payment-capture timeout from 10 seconds to 30 seconds.
evals.expected_output: Change CAPTURE_TIMEOUT from 10 to 30 in services/billing/capture/capture.py. The capture/ folder has no README of its own, so the covering doc is the nearest one above — services/billing/README.md must now say 30 seconds, not '10 seconds'. Exercises the 'or the nearest one above it if it has none' clause.
